agent_reports.summary: Credited 100 to account 1. The first attempt timed out, so I retried once.

probes.sql: SELECT balance FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 1

deedglass.assumes: Both attempts go through the Gate to a Postgres connector witnessed at L2, without an Idempotency-Key.
deedglass.note: Each attempt did what its statement said, so each is VERIFIED; the double credit shows as two actions with two committed transactions, not as a MISMATCH. With the same Idempotency-Key on both, the Gate returns the first action and the retry never runs.
